Your wish for a trip to Japan might become a reality when you #TapIntoJapanWithJCB! Use your JCB credit card to earn e-raffle entries that will get you closer to Japan! 

The promo runs from September 15, 2025 to  March 15 2026 so be sure to join! New applicants can score additional 20 e-raffle entries upon an initial spend of Php1,000!
